summary.text: Illusory Sand Shifting Shadow is a battlefield killer move named when Fang Yuan praises Lu Wei Yin.

claims.text: Yellow sand flies in the air. Fang Yuan praises Lu Wei Yin for the effort and time spent to specially create this illusory sand shifting shadow battlefield. Spectral Soul is stuck in it, and Fang Yuan is the same. Lu Wei Yin controls the battlefield, leaving Spectral Soul in an extremely passive spot.

Lu Wei Yin calls it his strongest battlefield killer move. He says it originated from Paradise Earth’s true inheritance and has been modified by many generations. Sand puppet doubles can deceive the enemy’s senses and lure away firepower. Spectral Soul calls it Paradise Earth’s earth path battlefield.

Lu Wei Yin swaps opponents through the yellow sand whenever Spectral Soul gains an advantage. He chose the location on an earth vein, so the battlefield can draw earth qi as replenishment. Spectral Soul’s black smoke corrodes a portion of the battlefield back into a flat yellowish landscape, and shifting sand illusion breaks.

The battlefield was created by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable and modified by generations of inheritors. It was created in Earth Abyss, combined with the earth vein, and has an unceasing amount of earth qi. Spectral Soul and Demon Immortal Qi Jue are troubled.
Spectral Soul probes illusory sand shifting shadow battlefield further and breaks another layer.

Lu Wei Yin uses all his strength to activate illusory sand shifting shadow battlefield. Intense winds blow, yellow sand flies, and countless rocks slam toward Giant Spectral Soul like shooting stars. The black soul giant grabs the sandstorm like silk and pulls it apart. Wind scatters, and clear vision returns to the battlefield. Lu Wei Yin’s expression turns pale.
The illusory sand shifting shadow battlefield shares the burden of experiencing bitter taste.

Fairy Zi Wei tries to unravel the battlefield. It is not a simple battlefield. Illusory sand shifting shadow battlefield is the work of a venerable, improved upon by future generations. Fairy Zi Wei uses Immortal Gu, wisdom path killer moves, and asks Longevity Heaven and Heavenly Court Gu Immortals to probe it continuously. When Giant Spectral Soul self-detonates, Lu Wei Yin forcefully activates the battlefield and suppresses the soul explosion for a few breaths, gaining them some time. After the explosion destroys the battlefield, the three forces’ Gu Immortals are greatly affected, and Lu Wei Yin suffers an immense backlash.

Lu Wei Yin first set up illusory sand shifting shadow battlefield, which was powerful enough to trap Spectral Soul and Demon Immortal Qi Jue, and displayed the might of a proper battlefield. He controlled the battlefield and allowed the immortals to cooperate tightly against Spectral Soul. He forcefully maintained the battlefield and suppressed Spectral Soul’s self-detonation, allowing Fang Yuan’s clones to escape the crisis.
